nodes.name: Call LLM (Web Search)
nodes.notes: KNOWN GAP: this used to use Claude's hosted web_search tool for live research in one call — OpenRouter/NVIDIA Nemotron has no equivalent server-side search tool, so this node currently just asks the model to answer from its own training data, which is stale and NOT grounded in real, verifiable sources. The prospector system prompt still forbids fabricating candidates, so expect it to return few or no candidates honestly rather than invent them. To restore real prospecting, add a search step before this node (e.g. call Tavily/Serper/Bing's API, feed the results into the user message here) and switch the model to one that supports tool-calling if you want a multi-turn research loop instead of a single search.
